critical.issue: slowapi.Limiter with key_func=get_remote_address does NOT enforce 12/min via the public k8s ingress URL — 15 consecutive POSTs all returned 200 from outside. Locally (curl http://localhost:8001/...) the 13th call correctly returns 429. Root cause: behind k8s ingress, request.client.host is the ingress controller IP (constant per cluster but possibly distributed across replicas), so the limiter buckets are either huge or rotated. Fix: use a custom key_func that prefers X-Forwarded-For header, e.g. `def key(request): xff = request.headers.get('x-forwarded-for'); return xff.split(',')[0].strip() if xff else get_remote_address(request)`. Without this fix, the rate-limit feature is effectively bypassed in production.

Returns 200 with {error: 'credentials_missing_or_endpoint_unreachable', configured: false} as expected (graceful). FYI when env vars are eventually set, ensure the parser ignores HTML-error responses (ParseError) gracefully.

rca of the issue: Symptom: Rate-limit annotation `@limiter.limit('12/minute')` on POST /api/sync/wtt does NOT return 429 when called 15× in a row from outside the cluster (https://rally-hub-6.preview.emergentagent.com/...), but DOES return 429 on the 13th call when called from inside the pod (curl http://localhost:8001/...). Root cause: slowapi.util.get_remote_address returns request.client.host. In the kubernetes ingress topology used here, request.client.host is the IP of the ingress controller (not the real client). Either (a) multiple ingress replicas distribute the requests across distinct internal IPs, each getting its own 12-call bucket, or (b) the bucket key resolves to a high-traffic shared IP that effectively never fills. In both cases the rate-limit is silently bypassed for every external caller. Mitigation: implement `def real_ip(request): xff = request.headers.get('x-forwarded-for') or request.headers.get('x-real-ip'); return xff.split(',')[0].strip() if xff else get_remote_address(request)` and pass it as `Limiter(key_func=real_ip)`. Verified locally that the 12/min bucket works — only the IP-detection layer is broken.
